name: Octomind
headline: Octomind - AI-Powered CLI Development Assistant
short_description: Octomind is an autonomous AI framework for CLI that enables developers to interact with codebases conversationally. It supports multimodal vision, integrates with multiple AI providers, and includes built-in MCP tools. Developers benefit from efficient codebase navigation, semantic search, and automated task execution.
author: Muvon

sections.overview:
Octomind is an open-source runtime for deploying specialist AI agents across any domain via a command-line interface. Agents are packaged expertise—complete with system prompts, MCP servers, model configurations, and tool permissions—fetched from a community tap registry and ready to run in seconds. The runtime handles adaptive context compression to maintain performance in long sessions, enforces spending caps and model selection per task, and governs autonomous behavior through deterministic policy scripts. Developers benefit from zero-config deployment, dynamic capability loading that activates only when relevant, and the ability to spawn sub-agents and enable MCP servers mid-conversation without restart.
Deploy domain-specific agents for medicine, law, finance, or DevOps without manual configuration
Enable agents to spawn sub-agents and activate new MCP servers mid-session based on task context
Control per-task costs and model selection across multiple AI providers with hard spending caps
Govern autonomous agent behavior with policy-as-code guardrails instead of approval workflows
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/Muvon/octomind`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
